text:
𝗣𝗔𝗞 𝗕𝗘𝗔𝗧 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗢𝗡 𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗧 𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗟! 🇵🇰

Blind T20 Asia Cup, Dhaka: India made 179/6; Pakistan got 180/9.
Nematullah hit a six and a four off the last two balls.

Heartbreak for India 💔 Final: Nov 20

#BlindCricket #AsiaCup

facebook.caption:
𝗣𝗔𝗞𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡 𝗡𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗞𝗢 𝗟𝗔𝗦𝗧 𝗕𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗣𝗔𝗥 𝗛𝗔𝗔𝗥𝗔𝗬𝗔! 🏏

👉 Blind T20 Asia Cup, Dhaka mein India ne 179/6 banaye
👉 Pakistan ko last 2 balls mein 7 runs chahiye the
👉 Nematullah ne 5th ball par six aur last ball par four maara, Pakistan 180/9 se 1 wicket se jeete
👉 Durga Rao ke 62 runs bekaar gaye, final 20 Nov ko hai

India ke liye dil tootne wali haar 💔 Aap kya kahoge? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #BlindCricket #AsiaCup
